about: An output that reads a run-dependent value reads nothing else (chapter 5 § 5.4). The note writes today, a computed node reading run.date. Invalid: it pipes the draft into string.upcase with node.today.value. Valid: node.today.value alone.
sentences: Deliverable 'note' reads input.consult_draft.content and the run-dependent node.today.value in one output at line 3; an output that reads a run fact reads nothing else.
